title: Gold: what is live at /sim today
summary: The published simulator as of the evening of 2026-10-16: new boat model, bucket, depower and brace, drone cam, foam on the back of the wave, welcome card and toolbar, auto quality.
problem: Make the simulator something to show people: one page, clear first minute, runs on a laptop and degrades gracefully on a phone.
implemented: One simulator page with a welcome card, toolbar (help, restart, share, full screen, about), friendly scenario names and an About page.
The v2 boat (V10 Gen 4 hull sections, dry hull has no lift, seat bucket), depower to idle and low brace, segmented trunk, drone camera.
Foam and spray streaks sit on the back of the wave.
Auto quality that follows the frame rate and the drawing-buffer size; phones start light.
review: Open the build, press Start paddling, and paddle for a minute in the default sea.
Switch the camera with V (try Drone), and open the Settings panel to change the scenario.
Tap Down three times, then once more.

questions.text: How smooth does it feel on your laptop (1 = stuttering, 5 = perfectly smooth)?
Did you notice the quality settings changing by themselves, and was a message shown?
What is the first thing that looks wrong?

known: The default desktop settings run at about 20 fps on an M1 Pro until auto quality steps down (item G-009).
The map inset's wave overlay costs 4 to 18 ms per frame (fixed in the next build).
Shilshole land height and sea floor are synthetic; the Gorge walls are procedural; the horizon is procedural.

git.subject: feat: auto quality follows the real frame time and the drawing-buffer size; phones start light; light-effects switch; Low mesh
